thesis: PLMR is a profitable, fast-growing specialty P&C insurer that gapped up on a clear Q3 beat and has held the gap on fading volume, a constructive consolidation under the 52-week high. Revenue growth of 58% with accelerating earnings growth and a forward P/E of 13.7 supports continuation, and the insurer is a financials name, a sector leading in the risk-off regime rather than the broken tech complex. The stock is extended (RSI 70.5), so the setup is a dip-buy in the entry zone rather than a chase, with a defined stop and reward/risk of about 2.8. Conviction is tempered by the risk-off tape and limited distance to the analyst mean target.
